objective: Privately and offline determine whether an existing DeploymentPackage is eligible to enter a future verified Phase 3 recompilation flow, without converting, executing, submitting, mutating, or exposing it.

inspection_contract.legacy_validation: Call the existing fail-closed DeploymentPackage validator without changing it.
inspection_contract.payload: Identify QASM or QCIS profile and hash bytes; never emit, normalize, rewrite, or return raw program text.
inspection_contract.source_ir: Report that verified import and recompilation are required; never cast CircuitIR to TargetIR.
inspection_contract.target: Compare capacity, profile, shots, topology evidence and snapshot completeness using canonical TargetCapabilities fields.
inspection_contract.identity: Reference legacy deployment identity only as an opaque digest and compute a separate deterministic report identity.
inspection_contract.provider: Treat provider/backend names as locators; exclude them from report identity and all portable compiler identities.
inspection_contract.eligibility: Eligibility permits only a future verified recompilation attempt and never means artifact-ready, executable, submitted, or production-compatible.

required_evidence: exact closed status and finding taxonomies
positive anonymous OpenQASM 2 OpenQASM 3 static and QCIS fixtures
invalid identity schema routing payload profile target capacity shots dynamic and privacy negatives
input objects remain byte-for-byte and structurally unchanged
equal inputs produce equal reports and identities across Python hash seeds
provider backend label and nonsemantic metadata changes do not alter report identity
program target semantic and eligibility changes alter report identity
bounded input metadata and finding behavior
no provider SDK network environment import hook global registry background worker or telemetry
no public export default-path or DeploymentPackage schema change
independent 10 100 1K and 10K offline inspection performance baseline before any budget proposal

rollback.mechanism: Delete the private checker and its tests and evidence.

pause_after: Stage 1 implementation, independent performance baseline, and budget review
